name: compressor-vscode
description: Reduce tool-output traffic in Copilot with source-preserving reads, search, outlines, confirmed commands and retained logs. Includes output-reduction reports and steering.
author: Andrey Vasilevsky <anvanster@gmail.com>

compressor.savingsWindow.description: Lookback window for the savings ticker and report.

compressor.mode.description: Read/search policy: full disables automatic compression; optimized/slim preserve source code and comments, collapse repeated log lines and bound search results. Explicit outline and execution tools still summarize. Exact ranges stay uncompressed; optional host budgets can bound whole-file results. Figures measure gross output reduction, not session savings.

compressor.showActualUsage.description: Append an 'actual usage' section to the savings report with authoritative token counts parsed from this project's Claude Code session transcripts (~/.claude). Off by default — it covers Claude Code only, not Copilot. Enable to see real per-model usage alongside the estimated savings.

enumDescriptions: Machine-local keyed hash of the workspace path. The key never leaves this machine and is never written to the ledger, so a shared report cannot be reversed to project names.
The workspace folder name in clear text. Anyone you share the report or ledger with sees your project names.
compressor.projectLabel.description: How the ledger records which workspace a reduction came from, so the savings report can break totals down by project. Hashed by default because the report is shareable; switch to 'name' only if clear-text project names are acceptable in it. The absolute path is never recorded either way.

languageModelTools.name: compressor_execute
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a noninteractive shell command in a trusted workspace after confirmation. Returns exit status, a diagnostic summary and a retained log ID. Use for tests and builds. Commands can modify files or access the network. Stops on timeout or 2 MB output limit, marking output partial. Retrieve omitted output with compressor_log.

cwd.description: Workspace directory; defaults to first root

languageModelTools.name: compressor_log
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve exact retained command output by log ID and 1-based offset/limit. Logs remain in this extension window memory for up to 30 minutes and the last five commands. An output-limited command has only a partial retained log. Retrieve instead of rerunning commands.

characterOffset.description: Continue an oversized selected range at this character offset

languageModelTools.name: compressor_read
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read workspace text with original line numbers. Source code and comments are preserved; repeated log lines may be collapsed with recovery ranges. Prefer relevant offset/limit ranges or a qualified symbol name. Use compressor_outline to discover symbols. Exact ranges and symbols are uncompressed. Whole-file reads suit small files or broad edits. Canonical workspace paths, plus tool results VS Code spilled to its own chat-session-resources folder; regular text files up to 8 MB only.

offset.description: 1-based start line for an exact uncompressed range

limit.description: line count for the exact range

symbol.description: Exact or qualified symbol name; do not combine with offset/limit

languageModelTools.name: compressor_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search workspace text using literal or JS regex matching. Regex evaluation is cancellable with a one-second per-file deadline; simplify patterns that time out. Narrow discovery with include and root (use an absolute path for ambiguous names). Use output=files or count for compact results. Partial scans are explicitly marked; continue capped matches using skip with unchanged inputs. Generated/dependency directories and unsupported files are excluded. Content results retain file paths and line numbers.

query.description: text or regular expression to search for

isRegex.description: treat query as a JS regular expression

include.description: glob of files to search, relative to the workspace (e.g. src/**/*.ts)

maxResults.description: maximum number of matches to return

root.description: Open workspace folder name or absolute path

contextLines.description: Surrounding lines per content match (default 0). Overlapping windows merge. Arrow marks selected matches; | marks context. Counts and skip exclude context.

skip.description: Matching lines to skip for continuation

languageModelTools.name: compressor_outline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discover source symbols, nested methods, provider-supplied signatures and exact ranges. Read implementation with compressor_read using symbol or offset/limit. Falls back to a basic TS/JS, Python, Rust or Go outline when no language provider is available. Never replaces content with a larger outline. Workspace-confined.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Compressor
walkthroughs.description: Compress large file reads in Copilot agent mode, steer the agent toward the tool, and watch your token savings.

steps.title: What Compressor does
steps.description: Fewer tokens, same work — Compressor shrinks the agent's reads, searches, and outlines before they reach the model. No network calls; chars exact, tokens estimated.

steps.title: Enable Copilot steering
steps.description:
Nudge Copilot agent mode toward compressor's tools — read, search, and outline.
[Enable Steering](command:compressor.enableSteering)

steps.title: Read with #compressorRead
steps.description: In an agent-mode chat, ask the model to read a large file with #compressorRead — see the example prompts to the right.

steps.title: Read, search & outline
steps.description: Five tools: #compressorRead, #compressorSearch (optional context), #compressorOutline, #compressorExecute and #compressorLog. See the example prompts to the right.
